Sort a list of tuples by the second element.

Supplied answer
students = [("Surya", 78), ("Amit", 92), ("Riya", 65)]
students.sort(key=lambda item: item[1])
print(students)
print(sorted(students, key=lambda item: item[1], reverse=True))
Note: key tells sort() what value to compare. lambda item: item[1] means "use the marks".
